relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis confirmed that increased ROS enhanced galectin-3 expression

relationships.subject: galectin-3
relationships.evidence_quote: galectin-3 promoted the release of TNF-α and IL-1β from BV2 cells, while pretreatment with TAK-242 significantly reduced its pro-inflammatory effect

relationships.subject: galectin-3
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, in vivo and in vitro experiments suggest that the nociceptive and pro-inflammatory effects of galectin-3 are mediated through the TLR4 receptor.

key_findings: Preoperative ROS raise spinal galectin-3, worsening postoperative hyperalgesia and neuroinflammation; galectin-3 effects depend on TLR4.
